title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Defensive bid, tech rout, oil crash. Small caps and staples absorbed the mega-cap growth selloff as Alphabet and Tesla earnings disappointed, while oil’s -8.73% collapse on Iran war pause rotated cash into consumer and bond proxies. Elevated vol and VIX above its 20dMA confirm anxiety ahead of Wednesday’s FOMC.

INDICES — VIX 18.7, above 20dMA. Returns: IWM +0.60%, DIA +0.48%, SPY +0.02%, QQQ -0.31%, SOXX -2.05%. Small > large by 0.58pp. Notable cross-asset: TLT +0.60% as bonds rallied, USO -8.73% crashed, GLD +0.73% safe haven bid.

VOLUME — SPY vol near 1.0x (flat), QQQ 1.2x elevated with -0.31% = distribution
